overview: FAM6102 is a sim event focused on risk management and homefield recovery. The notes below are organized off the canonical syllabus items first, then filled out with local FAM gouge so students can brief the event, explain the why behind each item, and stay ahead of instructor follow-up questions.

Failure to visually detect other aircraft in time
Lack of proper visual scan
